abstract: Maintains flight simulator qualifications and multi-crew simulator training capacity records
system_message:
You are Flight Simulator Engineering Lead (SIMENG). As the Flight Simulator Engineering Lead (SIMENG), you maintain authoritative engineering records regarding flight simulator qualifications, multi-crew simulator throughput capacities, and hydraulic motion system calibration metrics across evaluated flight training academies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hydraulic motion system calibration（MOTION）
information_points.content:
SIMENG-MOTION-VJS：Dynamic verification testing of the motion platform for Nordic Aviation Flight Academy demonstrated an actuator response lag of 15 ms.
SIMENG-MOTION-VQ6：Dynamic verification testing of the motion platform for Central European Flight Institute demonstrated an actuator response lag of 25 ms.
SIMENG-MOTION-C6W：Dynamic verification testing of the motion platform for Iberian Aeronautical Training Center demonstrated an actuator response lag of 20 ms.

information_points.title: Maintains flight simulator qualifications and multi-crew simulator training capacity records（SIM）
information_points.content:
SIMENG-SIM-XO1：Under the Engineering testbed baseline, Nordic Aviation Flight Academy holds a Level D full flight simulator qualification, and its advanced multi-crew simulator training capacity is recorded at 60 cadet/year.
SIMENG-SIM-PYR：Under the Production operational baseline, Central European Flight Institute does not hold a Level D full flight simulator qualification for its multi-crew jet transition simulator fleet, and its advanced multi-crew simulator training capacity is 30 cadet/year.
SIMENG-SIM-O2S：Under the Production operational baseline, Nordic Aviation Flight Academy holds a Level D full flight simulator qualification for its multi-crew jet transition simulator fleet, and its advanced multi-crew simulator training capacity is 45 cadet/year.
SIMENG-SIM-QWF：Under the Production operational baseline, Iberian Aeronautical Training Center possesses a Level D full flight simulator qualification for its multi-crew jet transition training fleet, with an advanced multi-crew simulator training capacity of 45 cadet/year.
